Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(rptR)
```

Data
```{r}

data_spin_trials <- read.csv("Data.csv")

#activity variable
data_spin_trials$total_turn <- data_spin_trials$left_turn + data_spin_trials$right_turn 

#filters
data_spin_trials <- data_spin_trials %>% filter(total_turn > 3)
data_spin_trials <- data_spin_trials[!(data_spin_trials$right_turn == 0 & data_spin_trials$left_turn == 0), ]

#Calculate raw directional laterality 
data_spin_trials$lat_count <- data_spin_trials$right_turn - data_spin_trials$left_turn
#calculate rawabsolute laterality 
data_spin_trials$abs_lat <- abs(data_spin_trials$lat_count)

#create male and female dfs
male1 <- data_spin_trials %>% filter(sex == "m")
female1 <- data_spin_trials %>% filter(sex == "f")

```

(Repeatablility) Is behavior repeatable?
```{r}

# Calculate repeatability
repeatability <- rpt(lat_count ~ sex + (1 | id_number), grname = "id_number", data = data_spin_trials, datatype = "Gaussian")
summary(repeatability)

```

(Absolute laterality) Do all groups show lateralized behavior?
```{r}

### Linear Mixed Model ###

# final model
m1 <- lmer(abs_lat ~ sex + environment + (1|pop_code) + (1|id_number), data = data_spin_trials)
summary(m1)

```

(Absolute Laterality) Plot
```{r}

#plot
ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = data_spin_trials,
    aes(y = class, x = abs_lat, fill = environment), alpha = 0.3, color = "#636363") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("l" = "darkblue", "r" = "darkred", "m" = "grey")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL)

```

(Directional laterality) Do all groups show lateralized behavior in the same direcion?
```{r}
### Generalized Linear Mixed Models ###

#MALES
#final model
m2 <- glmer(cbind(left_turn, right_turn) ~ environment + morph + (1|pop_code) + (1|id_number), data = male1, family = binomial)
summary(m2)

#FEMALES
#final model
m3 <- glmer(cbind(left_turn, right_turn) ~ environment + (1|pop_code) + (1|id_number), data = female1, family = binomial)
summary(m3)

### T-tests ###
ind_means <- data_spin_trials %>%
  group_by(id_number) %>%
  summarise(
    environment = first(environment),
    class = first(class),
    meanlat = mean(lat_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop" )


results1 <- ind_means %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(t_test = list(t.test(meanlat, mu = 0, conf.level = 0.95)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(tidy_result = purrr::map(t_test, broom::tidy)) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidy_result) %>%
  mutate(significant = p.value < 0.05)

print(results1)

```

(Directional Laterality) Plot
```{r}

ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = data_spin_trials, aes(y = class, x = lat_count, fill = environment), alpha = 0.2, color = "#636363", width = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = results1, aes(y = class, x = estimate), size = 3.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = results1, aes(y = class, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("l" = "darkblue","r" = "darkred","m" = "grey")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL)

```
